technology.excerpt: The 582-tonne superconducting magnet stores three times the energy of its ITER counterpart and was built entirely with domestic technology.
technology.nri_angle: India is an ITER consortium member; China's rapid fusion progress raises questions about India's own fusion investment strategy
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: Netflix's Musafir Cafe Has Viewers Hunting for a Real Cafe in Uttarakhand
entertainment.excerpt: Vikrant Massey's romantic drama, set in Mussoorie's misty hills, has sparked a wave of fans searching for the show's mountain cafe — but the truth is more complicated than a Google Maps pin.
entertainment.nri_angle: The show taps into the diaspora's romanticised longing for Indian hill-station life and the idea of escaping to a simpler world in the mountains.
entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: Sanjay Leela Bhansali Ditches Teaser for Immersive Love & War Launch in August
entertainment.excerpt: The filmmaker is personally shaping a special promotional asset to introduce audiences to the world of his upcoming film starring Ranbir Kapoor, Alia Bhatt, and Vicky Kaushal.
entertainment.nri_angle: Love & War is a prestige Bollywood event film expected to drive significant theatrical demand among diaspora audiences worldwide.
entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: Social Media Star Niharika NM Makes Bollywood Debut in Bhai Tera Star Hai
entertainment.excerpt: The content creator-turned-actress, who walked away from a thriving social media career with over 6 million followers, stars alongside Raghav Juyal in the London-set comedy releasing July 31.
entertainment.nri_angle: Niharika NM's trajectory from a Chapman University MBA in California to a multilingual film career in India mirrors the creative pull many diaspora Indians feel toward opportunities back home.
entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: Karan Johar Credits Shah Rukh Khan and Aditya Chopra for His Career on Guru Purnima
entertainment.excerpt: The filmmaker shared an emotional Instagram tribute recalling two life-changing conversations — a 1 AM phone call from Chopra and a hilltop promise from Khan — that launched his three-decade career in Hindi cinema.
entertainment.nri_angle: Films like DDLJ and Kuch Kuch Hota Hai became cultural touchstones in NRI households worldwide, making the creative bonds behind them deeply personal for diaspora audiences.
entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: Suneil Anand, Son of Bollywood Legend Dev Anand, Dies at 70 in London
entertainment.excerpt: The actor, director and custodian of the iconic Navketan Films banner suffered a heart attack in London on Saturday, ending a life intertwined with Indian cinema royalty.
entertainment.nri_angle: Suneil spent much of his life between Mumbai and London, and his death in the same city as his father carries poignant symmetry for diaspora communities who grew up with Dev Anand's films.
entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Lung Cancer Surges Among Young Non-Smoking Women in India
lifestyle-health.excerpt: Non-smoking women in their 40s now account for up to 40 percent of female lung cancer cases in India, driven by air pollution, indoor cooking fumes, and genetic mutations — while screening protocols still focus on older male smokers.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: EGFR mutations prevalent in Asian populations make genetic risk factors relevant for Indian diaspora families, while air quality and indoor cooking exposure during visits to India compound the concern.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Cancers Once Diagnosed at 60 Are Now Striking People in Their 30s and 40s, and Researchers Think They Know Why
lifestyle-health.excerpt: A landmark Nature Medicine study links accelerated biological aging in younger generations to the global surge in early-onset cancers, with implications for how we screen and prevent the disease.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: India faces rising early-onset cancer rates; South Asians in Western countries show elevated risk for certain cancers in younger age groups.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Delhi High Court Refuses to Halt India's HPV Vaccination Drive, Seeks Centre's Response on Safety Concerns
lifestyle-health.excerpt: The court declined a stay on the national immunisation programme but called the issue 'very important' and ordered responses from ICMR, CDSCO, and NITAG.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: HPV vaccination is standard in Western countries where most NRIs live; India's rollout and safety debate directly affects families with children in India.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: GLP-1 Weight Loss Drugs Linked to Sharply Lower Risk of Obesity-Related Cancers, Studies Show
lifestyle-health.excerpt: Multiple large-scale studies suggest medications like Ozempic and Mounjaro may reduce cancer risk by up to 65 percent for some tumour types, with researchers now investigating mechanisms beyond weight loss.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: With obesity and diabetes rates rising sharply among South Asians, GLP-1 drugs' potential anti-cancer benefits carry particular relevance for the Indian diaspora.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Cambridge Study Reveals Why Some Smokers Get Cancer and Others Do Not
lifestyle-health.excerpt: A landmark Nature study finds that inherited genetics — not just environmental exposure — shapes how tumours evolve after DNA damage, offering the first direct evidence for a long-suspected link.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: A Cambridge study found that certain DNA repair mechanisms determine why some long-term smokers develop cancer while others do not.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: India has among the highest rates of tobacco-related cancers globally, and understanding population-specific genetic risk could lead to better-tailored screening for Indian communities worldwide.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Plant-Forward Planetary Health Diet Linked to 28 Percent Lower Heart Disease Risk in Women
lifestyle-health.excerpt: A 20-year study of more than 65,000 postmenopausal women found that even moderate adherence to the EAT-Lancet diet — rich in vegetables, whole grains and legumes — was associated with significantly reduced cardiovascular risk.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: The Planetary Health Diet aligns closely with traditional Indian dietary patterns built around dal, vegetables and whole grains, providing scientific validation for long-standing culinary wisdom.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Sanjay Dutt at 67: Six Meals a Day and a Weakness for Biryani
food.excerpt: As Bollywood's 'Baba' marks his 67th birthday, a look at the disciplined six-meal diet that keeps him camera-ready — and the cheat-day indulgences he refuses to give up.
food.nri_angle: Dutt's diet bridges Indian culinary heritage — his mother Nargis's rogan josh, Mughlai kebabs, and biryani — with modern wellness practices familiar to diaspora audiences balancing desi food traditions with healthy eating.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Dahi Wale Tinde: The Yogurt Curry That Makes Humble Tinda Irresistible
food.excerpt: This North Indian summer staple transforms the often-dismissed apple gourd into a tangy, spiced yogurt curry that pairs perfectly with roti or paratha.
food.nri_angle: Tinda is available seasonally at Indian grocery stores in the US, UK, and Canada, typically between June and September, making this a timely summer recipe for diaspora kitchens.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: AI Calorie-Tracking Apps Undercount by Hundreds of Calories, NIH Study Finds
food.excerpt: Photo-based nutrition apps underestimated meal calories by 250 to 345 on average, with fat miscounted by about 30 grams — and the errors are worse for mixed dishes common in Indian cuisine.
food.nri_angle: AI calorie-tracking apps perform worst on mixed Asian and Indian dishes like biryani and dal, making them unreliable for health-conscious diaspora users relying on these tools.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Bengaluru Restaurants Set August 15 Deadline to Quit Swiggy and Zomato
food.excerpt: Restaurant owners in India's tech capital are giving food delivery platforms a month to lower commissions or face a mass delisting, joining a nationwide revolt that has already seen entire towns pull their menus from the duopoly.
food.nri_angle: Indians abroad who use Swiggy and Zomato to send meals to family or order ahead before visits may find fewer restaurants on the platforms, while diaspora-funded restaurant investments face new questions about the sustainability of platform-dependent business models.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Air India Partners With Ministry of Tourism to Boost Incredible India Globally
travel.excerpt: The MoU will leverage Air India's five-continent network and the government's Incredible India initiative to drive co-branded marketing, transit tourism, and trade engagement.
travel.nri_angle: Improved transit tourism at Delhi and Mumbai hubs and loyalty programme tie-ups could benefit NRIs transiting through or visiting India.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Dubai's 'Invite' Scheme Offers $800 in Perks to Revive Post-War Tourism
travel.excerpt: UAE residents who nominate overseas visitors arriving before October 31 can unlock hotel stays, attraction tickets, and dining deals worth over AED 3,000 — part of Dubai's aggressive push to rebuild its tourism brand after the Iran conflict.
travel.nri_angle: Over 700,000 Indian nationals in Dubai can use the programme to bring family from India during peak VFR season, with visa-on-arrival eligibility simplifying the process.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Air India Launches 'Easy Connect' From Amritsar, Linking Punjab to 27 Global Destinations
travel.excerpt: Punjab travelers can now fly internationally through Delhi without changing terminals or rechecking baggage, as Air India expands its hub-and-spoke model to its second regional city after Varanasi.
travel.nri_angle: Punjab's large overseas community — with frequent travel to Canada, the US, UK, and Australia — gains a direct international gateway at Amritsar with seamless baggage and immigration handling.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Air India Turnaround Could Take a Decade, Tata Sons Chief Warns as Losses Double to $2.3 Billion
travel.excerpt: Tata Sons Chairman N. Chandrasekaran extends the airline's transformation timeline to five to ten years, citing supply-chain disruptions, legacy systems, and the fallout from last year's fatal crash.
travel.nri_angle: NRI travelers face reduced Air India options on key North American, European, and Australian corridors during the extended turnaround, though new aircraft deliveries from 2027 promise improved service.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: US Senator Pushes Bill to Grant Green Cards to Immigrants After Seven Years of Residency
carousel.excerpt: Senator Alex Padilla's legislation would update a 1929 immigration law, potentially opening a pathway for up to 8 million people including H-1B visa holders stuck in decades-long backlogs.
carousel.nri_angle: Hundreds of thousands of Indian-origin H-1B holders face Green Card wait times exceeding 100 years under the current system — this bill could offer a dramatic shortcut.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Assam Floods Kill 75 as Entire Villages Vanish Across Upper Assam
carousel.excerpt: A cloudburst in Nagaland triggered catastrophic flooding across seven districts, displacing over 3 lakh people and submerging more than 45,000 hectares of farmland in what residents call the worst deluge in living memory.
carousel.nri_angle: The devastating Assam floods connect deeply with the Indian diaspora, many of whom have family in the affected Upper Assam districts and are watching the destruction of ancestral villages from abroad.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Esha Singh Clinches Second Consecutive World Cup Gold as India Sweeps Two Medals in Hangzhou
carousel.excerpt: The 21-year-old world record holder dominated the women's 25m pistol final with 40 hits, while Paris Olympic double medalist Manu Bhaker claimed bronze after a tense shoot-off.
carousel.nri_angle: India's shooting resurgence has become a compelling diaspora sports storyline; the Esha-Manu partnership represents a new generation of Indian athletes competing at the highest level
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Tim Cook Bids Farewell as Apple Posts Record $109.4 Billion Quarter
carousel.excerpt: In his final earnings call as CEO, Cook presided over Apple's strongest June quarter ever, with iPhone sales surging 22% and profits beating Wall Street forecasts — but a cautious Q4 outlook sent shares lower after hours.
carousel.nri_angle: Apple's leadership transition and AI strategy are closely watched by Indian tech professionals in Silicon Valley and the broader diaspora, many of whom work across Apple's ecosystem.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Rivian Beats Revenue Estimates, Raises Delivery Outlook as R2 SUV Gains Traction
carousel.excerpt: The EV maker posted $1.66 billion in Q2 revenue, a 27% jump, while its mass-market R2 SUV drove higher delivery guidance and a path toward positive gross margins.
carousel.nri_angle: Rivian's strong quarter and growing software business—bolstered by its Volkswagen joint venture—signal opportunities for investors tracking the EV sector's evolution amid shifting U.S. policy.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk
